item.remoteandroids.observer_core.desc: Spawns an observer android that can only watch. Cannot interact with anything.
item.remoteandroids.adventure_core.desc: Spawns an adventure android. Can observe but cannot break or place blocks.
item.remoteandroids.survival_core.desc: Spawns a survival android. Can interact freely and has a persistent inventory.
item.remoteandroids.neural_remote.desc: Bind to an android by right-clicking it, then use to transfer consciousness. Press the disconnect keybind to return.
item.remoteandroids.disconnect.desc: Use to return to your body. You can also use the keybind.
remoteandroids.msg.android_activated: A new android has been activated.
remoteandroids.msg.remote_rebound: Remote re-bound to a new android.
remoteandroids.msg.already_bound: This remote is already bound to that android.
remoteandroids.msg.not_bound_yet: This remote isn't bound yet. Right-click an android to bind it.
remoteandroids.msg.already_controlling: You are already inhabiting an android.
remoteandroids.msg.android_missing: That android no longer exists. Remote unbound.
remoteandroids.msg.not_controlling: You aren't inhabiting an android right now.
